title: A current vanishing off K only sees test forms on a neighbourhood of K
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ and V, K, N ⊆ ℝ^P with N open and K ⊆ N. Let Z ∈ D_q(V) (GeometricCurrentOn V q) satisfy Z(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ D^q(V) (TestFormOn V q) whose tsupport is disjoint from K. Then Z(η) = Z(ω) for all ω, η ∈ D^q(V) with η(x) = ω(x) for every x ∈ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (V K N : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn V q), IsOpen N → K ⊆ N → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V q, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q)) K → Z ω = 0) → ∀ ω η : TestFormOn V q, (∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x = (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x) → Z η = Z ω
